quest_lastdenn_ryiah.name: Ryiah
quest_lastdenn_ryiah.comment: WARNING: phraseId 20 is used in a conv condition.

text: Psst. You there, with the face that says "bad ideas welcome".
They threw me in this cell because they think I'm a witch.
And true, I am a witch. But that's not the point.
Witches don't belong in jail. They belong outside jails, where they can be free to do witchy things.
If you'll help me achieve that, perhaps I can use those witchy things to help you out in return.

choices.text: *Ask what she needs.*
*No illegal prison break for you. Take your leave.*

text: A guard is off duty somewhere in the bar.
How do I know that? Because I'm a witch! I know things.
He has my jail key. And you need to get it from him.
He is probably drunk, so this shouldn't be too difficult, but also not easy.
Don't forget, my freedom is on the line here. Good luck!
You're back?
Do you have the jail key? Are you serious? What are you waiting for?
*Hic*
Hey. I'm off duty. *Hic* Way off duty.
Whatever it is... talk to the night shift. They're on. I'm not. Not until morning.
You're actually going to stand there until I hear you out?
Fine. I've had a few drinks and I've got a few minutes. *Hic* What.

choices.text: *Ask him directly if he's still carrying the jail key from his shift.*
*Tell him there's been a complaint about something on his block tonight.*
[Barbarian 1] *Step in close. Make clear this won't be polite.*
[Diplomat 1] *Appeal to his experience - you need his jail key tonight.*
[Jester 1] *Claim you're the entertainment for his shift break.*
*Leave him to his drink.*

text: Alright. Back up. Now.
I've had a few but I know that look. *Hic* I'm not looking for trouble. But I'm also not... scared.

choices.text: *Demand he cooperate and stop wasting your time.*
[Diplomat 1] *De-escalate and explain his jail key is needed urgently.*
[Jester 1] *Offer to buy him another round to talk this out.*
*Take your leave.*

text: De-escalate. Explain the urgency. You threaten me and now... you're being reasonable.

choices.text: *Tell him you need his jail key in the next ten minutes.*
[Jester 1] *Lighten the mood and ask for his jail key.*
*Take your leave.*

text: Wait. You threaten me and now... you're buying rounds? *Hic*

choices.text: *Ask him quietly to help you with one small favour.*
[Diplomat 1] *Assure him you need his jail key - this is serious.*
*Take your leave.*

text: My experience. My jail key. *Hic* You know how to talk to people.
Alright. What's this about?

choices.text: *Ask him where you can find someone in charge tonight.*
[Barbarian 1] *Lean in closer. Make it clear there are no other options.*
[Jester 1] *Point out his shift's over - so is his responsibility.*
*Take your leave.*

text: Alright. You're... you're making a point. *Hic* I get it.

choices.text: *Tell him this is coming from someone above his rank.*
[Jester 1] *Suggest passing the jail key and calling it a night.*
*Take your leave.*

text: Shift's over, responsibility's over. *Hic* I like the logic. Terrible logic, but I like it.

choices.text: *Offer to put something in writing right now to cover him.*
[Barbarian 1] *Demand his jail key. The talking's over.*
*Take your leave.*

text: Entertainment. For my shift break. That's... that's a new one.
Alright. You've got my attention. What is it?

choices.text: *Tell him you just need to borrow his jail key for about an hour.*
[Barbarian 1] *Drop the charm. Demand his jail key now.*
[Diplomat 1] *Make it clear - you need his jail key and it matters.*
*Take your leave.*

text: Alright alright. That look's back. *Hic* What do you actually need?

choices.text: *Tell him you'll make it worth his while.*
[Diplomat 1] *Persuade him you're trusting him with the jail key.*
*Take your leave.*

text: You need it and it matters. *Hic* You're making this sound important.

choices.text: *Ask him directly if his answer is yes.*
[Barbarian 1] *Lock eyes. His jail key. Now.*
*Take your leave.*

text: Threats... explaining urgency... now jokes about the key. *Hic* Fine.
Threats, then jokes, now you need my jail key and it's serious. *Hic* Alright.
Persuasion... then pressure... now jokes about the key. *Hic* Why not.
Jokes, then persuasion, then demands. *Hic* Should've seen that.
Jokes, then threats, now trust. *Hic* That's quite a performance. Alright.
Jokes, then explaining... then that stare. *Hic* You're pushy. Fine. Take it.
I want that back before morning shift. Not... not one minute after.
If anyone asks, you found it somewhere. I wasn't anywhere near this.
And if this comes back on me... *Hic* I'll remember. I will.
Why would you... ask me that?
I don't talk about duty equipment. Not with strangers. Not off duty. Not ever.
If you've got a real reason... say it.
A complaint. About... my block?
If there's a complaint, that goes through the duty sergeant. Not me. Not in a bar.
Come back in the morning. With something written down.
Cooperate with what? You haven't... you haven't told me anything.
Whatever it is, just say it.
Someone in charge... that's Sergeant Farren. *Hic* He's doing rounds. Until... two, I think.
If you wait for him though... he doesn't like interruptions. At all.
Borrow it. For an hour.
I like you. You're... direct. But the answer's no.
Ten minutes or ten days... doesn't change anything.
That's not... that's not how this works.
A favour. You were threatening me and now... you're asking favours.
You need to tell me what the favour is first.
Then whoever's giving that order can... can come down here themselves.
I don't act on authority I can't see.
In writing. Right now. In... a bar.
I've done this job twelve years. A napkin doesn't count.
I'm going to pretend... I didn't hear that.
Keep talking. Before I end this.
You're asking if... if my answer is yes.
Give me a reason. Not questions.
You again. *Hic* I still have it. Just... take it before I think about this too much.
I already said everything. Go.
Wait. Who are you? My new guard, or my new favorite person?
Actually, do not answer. I am deciding you are my new favorite person.
Before I make my dramatic exit, anything you want to say?
You did it! You actually did it! I am out!
I know I can be a handful, but I promised to be useful, and I keep my promises.

choices.text: *Briefly explain your time-travel predicament to defeat Ardor.*
*Ask Ryiah to join you on your quest.* [BLUE](Join party)
*Tell her you don't need her help right now.*

14.name: Ryiah
text: You just broke a witch out of jail. Let's make it worth the trouble.

20.name: Ryiah
text: Fine, but don't forget that I owe you one. If you ever need my help, just ask.

9000.name: Ryiah
text: I cannot repay my debt to you if I cannot join you. Make some room in your party and then talk to me again.
You're dismissing a witch. Bold move.
I do hope you've thought about what you're giving up here.

choices.text: *Yes, you've thought about it. She can go.* [BLUE](Dismiss Ryiah)
*On reflection, no. Witches are useful.*

text: Fine. Don't come crying to me when things go sideways without magical backup.
All her equipment will also be gone once you bury her.

choices.text: *Yes, let the funeral continue.* [RED](Dismiss Ryiah)
*No, take precautions first.*

text: Oh, you came back. Ran into trouble without your witch, did you?

choices.text: *Yes. Without a witch, this party is just problems.* [BLUE](Join party)
*No, you just happened to walk past.*

text: Thought so. I still owe you one anyway. Let's go.
Sure you did. I'll be here when you're ready to stop lying to yourself.
I would love nothing more than to rejoin you. But even a witch can see there's no room. Come back when you've made space.
